    Profile

    Zwei is a young girl who is known as the Veda Templar's "Number Two." She has therian blood coursing through her veins, and has endured harsh experimentation in order to forcefully imbue her with Beast Form powers. After resigning herself to the treatment, she made a friend out of her shadow, named Kuro. She's indifferent to most things, but tends to be emotionally unstable, at times exhibiting a dangerous temperament.

    Origin: Lost Blue
    Gender: Female
    Height: 145cm
    Weight: 36kg
    Birthday: Aug 19
    Blood Type: Type Qe
    Zodiac: Moon of the Swift Sails
    Likes: Freedom, Walks
    Hobbies: Thinking of ways to break out
    Illust: だーくろ
    CV: 咲々木瞳
